regime_context: China A-shares exhibit a Technology-led momentum structure with AI Compute & Optics as the headline leader and Semiconductors as a close challenger. The absolute-trend gate has historically not reduced drawdown on this market (gate_helps false), so the validated edge is absent; momentum ranks themselves lack predictive content, leaving only coincident narrative assessment. Only 6 of 22 themes are eligible, rotation is narrowing, and the macro backdrop is dominated by ai_tech headlines with high unscheduled news share (0.59).
emerging_watch: Watch for a confirmed leadership handoff from AI Compute & Optics to Semiconductors. Condition: Semiconductors becomes rank 1 with a score margin >0.3 over AI Compute & Optics for two consecutive weekly observation points. Kill-criterion: the margin shrinks below 0.1 or AI Compute regains the lead.

theses.subject: Semiconductors
theses.thesis: Semiconductors show robust trend health (durability_bar 0.7, hurst_tag trend) with broader participation (breadth 0.409) than the leader and are not crowded. falsifier.text: The overweight call is invalidated if the ETF 512760.SS closes below its 50-day simple moving average on a weekly timeframe, breaking the established uptrend.
